observation: Builder src/render/characters/vesperModel.js, dispatched by visualFactory.js:7991 (e.data.vesper). Six finishes are created per instance (8-19) and all six are used — the lamp tint is pitch-selected, so color variants do not allocate throwaway materials. bake() (38-53) merges static direct children per material, and it is applied exactly where the part is rigid: hull (106), fixed head shell (145), finger sub-assemblies (159), bell housing (236). Deliberate dynamic seams preserved: wing joints and irises/lenses (134), head assembly, individual fingers, the chorus petals, the clapper and resonance ring, and the lamp/indicator meshes; the harmonic ribbons are their own shader geometries (59-80) and are driven by joint state, not merged. Every source and merged geometry is disposed after baking (49-52), and teardown is explicit (261-265). No per-frame material or geometry allocation. Budget guarded by test/vesper-model.test.mjs.
decision: Keep. No construction change recommended; baking coverage and preserved animated seams are correct. Recommend needs follow-up until current captures exist.
next: Needs current gameplay-scale and close Vesper captures (pitch variants, wings/fingers, chorus) plus draw cost; static source review is not visual acceptance.
